text_blocks.snippet: The survival time of the COVID-19 virus on surfaces varies depending on several factors, including:

list.snippet: Type of surface: The virus can survive longer on smooth, non-porous surfaces like plastic, metal, and glass compared to rough or porous surfaces like cloth, wood, and paper.
Temperature and humidity: The virus survives longer in warm, humid environments.
Strain of virus: Different strains of the virus may have different survival times.

text_blocks.snippet: According to current research, the virus can survive on surfaces for:

list.snippet: Up to 24 hours: On plastic, metal, and glass
Up to 6 hours: On cardboard and wood
